title: Iraq suspends oil exports for 30 days
description: Iraq halted roughly 1.8 mb/d of official crude exports for 30 days to protest Israel's West Bank incursion, withdrawing about 2% of global supply

title: Gulf states impose diplomatic and transport blockade on Qatar
description: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt and Bahrain cut ties and closed land/air/sea links to Qatar, raising Gulf shipping and oil/LNG transit-risk premiums

title: OPEC+ agrees deeper 500kbd production cut
description: OPEC+ deepened output cuts by an extra ~500 kb/d to about 1.7 mb/d total for Q1 2020, tightening supply ahead of the Aramco IPO

title: OPEC+ accelerates output hike to 648kbd
description: OPEC+ pulled forward September's increase, lifting July and August output by about 648 kb/d each to ease a tight post-invasion market

title: OPEC+ announces gradual unwind of voluntary cuts
description: OPEC+ laid out a plan to phase 2.2 mb/d of voluntary cuts back into the market from October 2024, a bearish forward-supply signal

title: OPEC+ delays output-hike revival to April 2025
description: OPEC+ pushed the start of its 2.2 mb/d supply unwind from January to April 2025 and slowed the pace, keeping barrels off the market longer

title: Retreating Iraqi forces torch Kuwaiti oil wells
description: Iraqi forces set fire to 600-730 Kuwaiti oil wells during their retreat, removing more than 1.5 mb/d of Kuwaiti output for months

title: Nigeria Warri unrest forces Niger Delta oil shut-in
description: Ijaw militia attacks forced Chevron and Shell to evacuate and shut in about 800 kb/d of Nigerian light-sweet crude

title: Russian state auctions Yukos unit Yuganskneftegaz
description: A forced state auction of Yukos's core ~1 mb/d production unit raised expropriation and supply-continuity risk on Russian crude exports

title: Turkish ground incursion into northern Iraq
description: Turkey's Operation Sun near the Kirkuk-Ceyhan export corridor raised the risk of disruption to northern Iraqi crude exports

title: Egyptian revolution erupts raising Suez transit risk
description: Mass unrest in Egypt threatened closure of the Suez Canal and SUMED pipeline, chokepoints for about 1.8 mb/d of crude and products

title: Egyptian military ousts Morsi reviving Suez fears
description: The coup and unrest at the Suez Canal and SUMED chokepoint renewed fears of disruption to crude and product transit

title: Houthis resume Red Sea attacks sinking Magic Seas
description: Renewed Houthi attacks near Bab-el-Mandeb revived the shipping-risk premium and Cape rerouting for oil flows through the chokepoint
